_note: Mod icon layouts, in pixels from the top-left anchor of slot 1. Each list has 8 entries, one per slot: 1 HS, 2 Stealth, 3 Random, 4 Fun, 5 Just, 6 Timing, 7 SongSpeed, 8 Auto / special mod. Colours are [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255.

menu._note: a single horizontal row, 45 px between slots

game._note: a 4+4 grid: top row slots 1-4, bottom row slots 5-8

value._note: the scroll and song speed numbers over their icons; the icons are about 37 px, so keep the font small
